en.label: EN
en.title: Biotech, Super Intelligence & the internet.
en.subtitle: Workouts, agents, vibe coding. And a lot of surfing.
en.bio: I’m interested in biotech, longevity and taking care of my health. I work out, build with agents, play with vibe coding, and spend plenty of time surfing the internet.
en.journalNote: Small notes, one day at a time.
en.journalEmpty: The first page is still blank.
en.reberry: Restoring a BlackBerry Classic. Recovery notes, working tools, and the keyboard that stays.
en.muse: A talking Muse companion on an ESP32-S3 reflective display. Voice, music, and a little personality.
en.whooper: A recovery, sleep and training coach for ChatGPT and Codex. Your own WHOOP account, connected.
en.xfxmd: A collaborative Markdown editor for the classroom.
en.gallery: A searchable collection of image prompts.
en.portrait: EazyLee wearing Apple Vision Pro, a puffer jacket, jeans and shell-toe sneakers
en.workoutNote: A little accountability, powered by WHOOP.
en.worksNote: Devices, software and experiments. Updated from my public repositories.
en.luck: A native iOS companion for a Bluetooth smart ring. Sleep, readiness and activity, built with SwiftUI.
en.berry: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text on BlackBerry 10. Font fallback patches without rebuilding Chromium.
en.workoutRule: One nudge per browser, per day.
en.workoutError: Couldn’t send that nudge. Try again.
en.workoutLimited: Enough nudges from here for today. Come back tomorrow.

zh-CN.label: 简
zh-CN.title: Biotech、超级智能，和互联网。
zh-CN.subtitle: 健身、Agent、Vibe Coding，还有网上冲浪。
zh-CN.bio: 我关注 Biotech 和 Longevity，专注养生，也认真 Workout。精神和赛博生活里，我玩 Agent、Vibe Coding，平时也爱网上冲浪。
zh-CN.noTranslation: 这篇日记的原文语言是
zh-CN.article2: 搭建自动化影音管理系统
zh-CN.reberry: 修复一部 BlackBerry Classic。记录恢复过程、可用的工具，以及留下来的实体键盘。
zh-CN.muse: 反射屏上的 Muse 小伙伴。基于 ESP32-S3，可以聊天、播放音乐，也有自己的小表情。
zh-CN.whooper: ChatGPT 和 Codex 中的恢复、睡眠与训练教练，连接你自己的 WHOOP 账户。
zh-CN.xfxmd: 面向课堂的多人协作 Markdown 编辑器。
zh-CN.gallery: 可以搜索的图像提示词收藏。
zh-CN.portrait: 戴 Apple Vision Pro、穿羽绒服、牛仔裤和贝壳头鞋的 EazyLee
zh-CN.workoutNote: 每天练一点，也欢迎你来监督。
zh-CN.worksNote: 最近做的设备、软件和实验，按公开仓库的更新排序。
zh-CN.luck: 蓝牙智能戒指的原生 iOS 伴侣。用 SwiftUI 整理睡眠、恢复和活动数据。
zh-CN.berry: 让 BlackBerry 10 浏览器正确显示中日韩文字，通过字体回退补丁实现，无需重编译 Chromium。
zh-CN.workoutRule: 同一浏览器每天可催一次。
zh-CN.workoutError: 这次没催成功，再试一次。
zh-CN.workoutLimited: 今天这里已经催得够多了，明天再来。
